design_findings_resolution.evidence: Semantic cache entries are eligible only after this active hash owner remembered the exact same cache object/key/result object and canonical serialized content digest. Owner retains strong references to cache/result, so object-id reuse cannot grant eligibility. New owner has empty history_results; outer exit clears eligibility and hashes. Retained historical Checker copies complete snapshot records and revalidates/registers them on every later run before gate body. Context/completion/attempt standalone and retained-stack regressions pass.

Shared first-read/cache-hit/final audit delegates to the existing _regular signature provider. First actual read uses existing stable streaming hash_file with signature-before/hash/signature-after comparison. No new raw-lstat Windows cache path was introduced. Local same-size restored-mtime/replacement/first-read races pass; no Windows runtime was run by reviewer.

checked_invariants.conclusion: Each validate_files call freshly validates original logical path, exact snapshot_root/logical ref membership and safe physical snapshot path, then compares caller-specific expected hash to cached/streamed digest. The digest memo stores no successful expected-hash verdict. Different expected hashes and changed membership/link refs are covered by tests.

Only already registered snapshots under an active owner delegate to shared digest. Ordinary files retain prior behavior. Tree listing and member link/type checks still execute each use; no tree-membership memo is substituted.

checked_invariants.references: sdd_history.py:snapshot_hash_scope around36-61; sdd_check.py:Checker.run around2460-2480; progress.py:workflow_progress around94-108
checked_invariants.conclusion: ContextVar plus explicit owner attachment shares one object across historical/progress module aliases. Checker and projection boundaries audit union; outermost scope audits again after nested helpers and on exceptions. Reset/decrement/clear occur in finally even if audit raises. Root changing_input is blocked before a passed report is returned. Tests mutate after child return, in progress-only paths, on first read and while another error is propagating.

Inactive retained owner depth0 is replaced by fresh owner, not reactivated. Historical stack affects existing semantic cache ownership but does not provide new-owner eligibility. Repeated root runs, standalone validate_files, standalone progress, retained historical Checkers and independent CLI process all revalidate.

checked_invariants.area: Dynamic read-only boundaries before hardlink writes
checked_invariants.conclusion: Continuation preflight is a bounded read-only scope that exits before capture_context/freeze_files creates hardlinks and changes inode ctime. Capture helpers and sdd_history main are not wrapped in a broad write-spanning memo scope. Each nested validation/checker boundary closes/audits before its normal writing phase. Synthetic hardlink-between-phases rehashes; hardlink-inside-readonly-phase blocks.

No legacy member, failure, reference, source inventory, finding, runtime observation, authority or semantic gate was removed. Existing _history_cache reset and _history_stack cycle behavior remain; new owner eligibility narrows unsafe reuse rather than replacing validation with cached acceptance. Both historical attempt views still run when semantically required.

coverage: One stable physical payload hash across actual root/ready projection plus historical child
First-read races, restored-mtime edits, same-size replacement, missing input, file/parent symlink, hardlink mutation
Error-path and child-only full-union final auditing
Semantic cache cache/result identity plus content and retained context/completion/attempt trust
Registered snapshot inventory reuse while tree listing repeats
independent_actual_verification.limits: Synthetic local fixture tests, not product checker timing, native Windows execution, actual archived payload validation or product/runtime/provider acceptance. Root-owned consolidated suite is separate and not claimed here.

limitations: No measured speedup or final long-checker performance claim. Same-owner semantic eligibility JSON serialization and repeated signature audits still incur work.
History operations containing legitimate writes intentionally split read-only phases; one CLI may create more than one fresh owner rather than trusting through hardlink mutation.
No new snapshot-directory extra-member enforcement is claimed beyond existing exact file-map/path and tree-selection checks.
This is a bounded source and focused-test correctness review, not a repository-wide security audit.
